name: FLOW (v0.5)
desc:
FLOW is no longer getting updates as us developers are getting MUCH more busy with our lives, please don't be sad and cry, we want you to make the most of your future. Thank you and have a good time wherever you go!

🚨THIS GAME IS STILL IN NOT IN FULL RELEASE, BUGS AND MORE CAN BE FOUND🚨

☀️ Your Soul is transported into the Void, a place of Reflection and Judgement. Are you brave enough to take on and tread upon this Wasteland? 🌱

[🎵If you are the creator of any of the songs used in FLOW, please reach out to us if you request to take it down or want to know if your song is in our game!🎵]

HEAVILY inspired by Grace (By the Fartering Few), DOORS (by @Lightning_Splash and @RediblesQW), SUNDOWNER (by @Xetheriance), and Nullscape (by @MartWaterimp)
